# WS Capital — wscapital.app

WS Capital offers a professional Martingale forex trading strategy with 1:500 leverage through BlackBull Markets brokerage.

## Affiliate Program
- Free registration as affiliate partner
- Commission: $250–$500 per activated investor depending on country
- Sub-affiliate: 10% extra commission from your team
- Real-time dashboard with clicks, registrations and deposits

## Trading Strategy
- 4-level Martingale with deposit divided by 15 risk units
- Levels use 1-2-4-8 units, R:R 1:2, Stop Loss and Take Profit on each level
- Free Pine Script Supertrend robot included via email
- TradingView Pro activated after deposit validation
- Copy Trading access included

## What investors receive
- 1:500 leverage brokerage account
- Free Pine Script trading robot (email attachment)
- TradingView PRO activation
- Copy Trading access + video tutorial
